rationale: Pivot from xgb_mcdropout_classifier (8-iter train sweep #641-#648 plateaued at 0-3/7 with avg_ann -5% to -39%, no monotone improvement) to new xgb_rank_fusion. Default 3/7 (W3/W4/W6 pass cleanly with WR 41-55% and ann +15-36%) on first try with a novel diverse-objective + rank-quantile-geometric-mean fusion mechanism; W7 narrowly misses (WR 38.6%, 1.4pp short). The 16-dim HP space spans both shared tree-shape and per-base loss-specific knobs (pos_class_weight, magnitude_scale, huber_slope, dro_strength), so train mode has wide search surface to find a combo that lifts the WR floor in W1/W2/W5 (where the geometric mean is currently too aggressive — quarterly_dro alone would have passed these windows). Lowering pos_class_weight (less aggressive strict-win base) and raising weight_smoothing (gentler DRO reweighting) are the leading hypotheses for the sweep.
